shots.focal_element: HubSpot wordmark with 'Customer Platform' line beneath, centred on a flat brand-colour field
shots.transition_other: video start (no incoming transition; anchors give null)
shots.typography: Geometric rounded sans (low-confidence guess: Lexend Deca or similar), bold wordmark over a regular-weight title-case subline, normal tracking; small regular-weight title-case nav labels appear later
shots.what_happens: Scattered white dots and fragments assemble into the HubSpot wordmark while 'Customer Platform' fades up from translucent to solid and small sparkle stars twinkle beside the sprocket; flat decorative shapes sit at the frame edges. From about 2.0 s a website nav bar (logo, Software, Pricing, Resources) slides in at the top, framing the brand card as a web page hero, and a cursor enters near 'Software'. Voice-over opens with 'Welcome to the HubSpot customer platform' (w0-w5) over the logo resolve.
shots.build_rebuild: Animate ~12 white circles/pills from random positions into the wordmark letter shapes over 0.5 s with ease-out, fade the subline from 30% to 100% opacity, then slide a 60 px white nav bar down from y=-60 at 2.0 s.

shots.focal_element: Product overview page with a 3x2 grid of hub cards and an orange 'How it works' button
shots.transition_other: page scroll: the brand hero from s001 scrolls up out of frame under the sticky nav, revealing the product section
on_screen_text: The HubSpot Customer Platform, Powered by AI
All of HubSpot's marketing, sales and service software on one platform.
shots.typography: Clean rounded sans throughout; semibold sentence/title-case headline, regular small subline, medium-weight card titles with registered/trademark marks and regular small descriptions, white medium label on the button; normal tracking
shots.what_happens: The page settles inside a white card on an orange field, with the 'Software' nav item underlined. A cursor glides across the hub cards (Marketing, Sales, Service) while narration lists 'powerful, flexible, and easy to use software built to help grow your business' (w7-w19), then travels down to click 'How it works' as 'Let's dive into how it works' begins (w20).
shots.build_rebuild: Build a static HTML product page with a 3x2 card grid inside a white panel on an orange background, and animate an SVG cursor along a bezier path over the cards that ends on the CTA button at about 9.0 s.

shots.shot_type_other: motion-graphic hub-and-spoke diagram (brand icons around a central CRM badge)
shots.focal_element: Central circular 'HubSpot Smart CRM, Powered by AI' badge with a segmented spinning ring
shots.typography: Rounded geometric sans; bold wordmark, semibold title-case 'Smart CRM', small regular 'Powered by AI'; text flips from dark to white when the badge fills orange; normal tracking
shots.what_happens: A circle grows out of the faded web page as it crossfades to a cream background. Inside sits the Smart CRM badge, ringed by a segmented dark ring whose segments rotate, while six faint white outline icons (star, bolt, heart, hexagon, arrow, play) drift around it. Around 13.5-14.0 s, as narration says the platform 'is connected' (w34-w35), the cursor clicks the badge: it fills orange from the centre, the six icons turn into solid orange gradient hub icons, and white connector spokes link them to the centre. At the end the ring opens out into a wider double ring.
shots.build_rebuild: Centre an SVG circle badge with a stroke-dasharray ring rotated continuously, place six icons on a 260 px radius, and on click scale an orange inner circle from 0 to 1 while each icon cross-fades from white outline to its gradient fill and draws a line to the centre with a 40 ms stagger.

shots.focal_element: Orange Smart CRM centre disc surrounded by six labelled hub icons on dark wheel segments
shots.transition_other: radial clock wipe: dark navy segments with jagged leading edges sweep round from the centre and replace the cream background
shots.typography: Rounded geometric sans; white semibold title-case hub labels with registered/trademark marks, white bold wordmark and 'Smart CRM' inside the disc; normal tracking
shots.what_happens: The cream background is swept away radially by dark navy wedges that split the frame into six segments separated by white spoke lines, each holding one hub icon. White labels (Sales Hub, Marketing Hub, Service Hub, Content Hub, Operations Hub, Commerce Hub) appear under the icons while narration says each product 'supports different functions of your business, but they're all built on a single' (w43-w52). Faint radial texture lines run through the segments.
shots.build_rebuild: Draw six SVG pie wedges in navy around a 230 px orange disc, reveal them with a conic-gradient mask whose angle animates from 0 to 360 degrees over 0.8 s, then fade in the six white labels.

shots.shot_type_other: motion-graphic platform stack diagram (product icons above a unified CRM layer)
shots.focal_element: A row of six hub icons sitting on top of a wide orange 'HubSpot Smart CRM' bar
shots.transition_other: morph: the wheel rotates and collapses while the round CRM disc stretches into a horizontal pill/bar and the hub icons line up in a row
shots.typography: Rounded geometric sans; small dark semibold title-case hub labels with registered/trademark marks under the icons, white bold wordmark and 'Smart CRM' on the orange bar, small regular 'Powered by AI'; normal tracking
shots.what_happens: The radial wheel spins away and the CRM disc morphs into a wide orange bar under a row of the six hub icons, matching 'a single, unified platform' (w52-w54). Soft cream and peach blocks frame the bar, and their edges shift slightly as the layout settles. Around 23.5 s, as narration reaches 'the same system of record' (w63-w67), a dark navy band opens between the icons and the bar, and orange circuit-style connector lines draw from each icon down into the CRM. The stack stays on screen into 'HubSpot's AI-powered' (w68-w70).
shots.build_rebuild: Lay out a flex row of six icon+label tiles above a full-width orange bar, then at 23.5 s animate a navy spacer's height from 0 to 70 px and draw six orthogonal SVG polylines (stroke-dashoffset to 0) from each tile to the bar centre.
